translations: SELECT source_id, name, language FROM sources WHERE source_id IN ('TNP','UBG','KJV','TR') ORDER BY CASE source_id WHEN 'TNP' THEN 0 WHEN 'UBG' THEN 1 WHEN 'KJV' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
books: SELECT book_id, abbr, name_en, name_pl FROM books b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verses v WHERE v.book_id=b.book_id AND source_id=?) ORDER BY position
lookupBook: SELECT book_id, abbr, name_en, name_pl FROM books WHERE abbr=?
chapters: SELECT chapter FROM verses WHERE source_id=? AND book_id=? GROUP BY chapter ORDER BY chapter
chapter: SELECT verse,text FROM verses WHERE source_id=? AND book_id=? AND chapter=? ORDER BY verse
chapterRuns: SELECT verse,ordinal,kind,text,styles,note_ordinal FROM verse_runs WHERE source_id=? AND book_id=? AND chapter=? ORDER BY verse,ordinal
comparison: SELECT v.source_id, s.name, s.language, v.text FROM verses v JOIN sources s USING(source_id) WHERE book_id=? AND chapter=? AND verse=? ORDER BY CASE v.source_id WHEN 'TNP' THEN 0 WHEN 'UBG' THEN 1 WHEN 'KJV' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
verseRuns: SELECT verse,ordinal,kind,text,styles,note_ordinal FROM verse_runs WHERE source_id='TNP' AND book_id=? AND chapter=? AND verse=? ORDER BY ordinal
note: SELECT label,body FROM verse_footnotes WHERE source_id='TNP' AND book_id=? AND chapter=? AND verse=? AND note_ordinal=?
words: SELECT verse,position,greek,form_key,strong,grammar,lemma,definition FROM strong_tokens WHERE book_id=? AND chapter=? ORDER BY verse,position
word: SELECT position,greek,form_key,strong,grammar,lemma,definition,grammar_human,transliteration FROM strong_tokens WHERE book_id=? AND chapter=? AND verse=? AND position=?
senses: SELECT DISTINCT form,source,polish,english,grammar,code,pronunciation,lemma,json_extract(raw_record,'$.englishKind') AS english_kind,json_extract(raw_record,'$.source') AS attribution FROM form_senses WHERE form_key=? ORDER BY source,form,polish,english
dictionaryInitials: SELECT DISTINCT substr(form_key,1,1) AS initial FROM form_senses ORDER BY initial
dictionaryPage: SELECT form_key,MIN(form) AS form FROM form_senses WHERE substr(form_key,1,1)=? GROUP BY form_key ORDER BY form_key
works: SELECT DISTINCT work_id FROM fathers_passages ORDER BY work_id
workChapters: SELECT DISTINCT chapter FROM fathers_passages WHERE work_id=? ORDER BY chapter
passage: SELECT ordinal,text FROM fathers_passages WHERE work_id=? AND chapter=? ORDER BY ordinal
tags: SELECT slug,title FROM tags ORDER BY title
tag: SELECT slug,title,description FROM tags WHERE slug=?
tagReferences: SELECT b.abbr AS book, r.chapter, r.verse FROM tag_verses r JOIN books b USING(book_id) WHERE r.slug=? ORDER BY b.position,r.chapter,r.verse
tagRanges: SELECT fragment FROM tag_ranges WHERE slug=? ORDER BY ordinal
verseTags: SELECT t.slug,t.title FROM tag_verses r JOIN tags t USING(slug) WHERE book_id=? AND chapter=? AND verse=? ORDER BY title
search: SELECT d.kind,d.source AS source_id,COALESCE(b.abbr,d.target) AS target,d.chapter,d.verse,d.text FROM corpus_fts f JOIN search_documents d ON d.doc_id=f.rowid LEFT JOIN books b ON d.kind='verse' AND b.book_id=d.target WHERE corpus_fts MATCH ? ORDER BY rank,d.doc_id LIMIT 50
interlinearChapter: SELECT verse,position,greek,polish,english,code,pronunciation FROM interlinear_tokens WHERE book_id=? AND chapter=? ORDER BY verse,position
neighbors: SELECT chapter,verse,'previous' AS direction FROM (SELECT chapter,verse FROM verses WHERE source_id='KJV' AND book_id=? AND (chapter,verse)<(?,?) ORDER BY chapter DESC,verse DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT chapter,verse,'next' AS direction FROM (SELECT chapter,verse FROM verses WHERE source_id='KJV' AND book_id=? AND (chapter,verse)>(?,?) ORDER BY chapter,verse LIMIT 1)
greekHomographs: SELECT grammar,form_key FROM strong_tokens WHERE strong>0 AND grammar<>'' GROUP BY grammar,form_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strong)>1
greekRelated: SELECT DISTINCT strong,grammar,form_key FROM strong_tokens WHERE strong IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY strong,grammar,form_key
greekSenses: SELECT form_key,source,polish,english,code,pronunciation,json_extract(raw_record,'$.englishKind') AS english_kind FROM form_senses WHERE form_key IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY rowid
greekVerseWords: SELECT greek,position FROM strong_tokens WHERE book_id=? AND chapter=? AND verse=? ORDER BY position
greekTagFathers: SELECT f.work_id,f.chapter,f.ordinal,f.text FROM tag_fathers r JOIN fathers_passages f USING(work_id,chapter,ordinal) WHERE slug=? ORDER BY work_id,chapter,ordinal
greekTagTexts: SELECT v.source_id,b.abbr,b.book_id,v.chapter,v.verse,v.text FROM tag_verses r JOIN verses v USING(book_id,chapter,verse) JOIN books b USING(book_id) WHERE slug=? ORDER BY b.position,v.chapter,v.verse,v.source_id
greekTagRuns: SELECT v.book_id,v.chapter,v.verse,v.kind,v.text,v.styles,v.note_ordinal FROM tag_verses r JOIN verse_runs v USING(book_id,chapter,verse) WHERE r.slug=? AND v.source_id='TNP' ORDER BY v.book_id,v.chapter,v.verse,v.ordinal
greekTagWords: SELECT w.book_id,w.chapter,w.verse,w.greek,w.position FROM tag_verses r JOIN strong_tokens w USING(book_id,chapter,verse) WHERE r.slug=? ORDER BY w.book_id,w.chapter,w.verse,w.position
greekAttested: SELECT DISTINCT form_key FROM form_senses WHERE form_key IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
